description: List the tokens trending on one chain right now, or the newest launches, the biggest gainers and (on Solana) the losers, the most traded and the most scanned on DEFADE. Use it to discover tokens when the user names none ("what is hot on Base", "show me new Solana launches"), then scan the ones that matter with get_token_scan and get_rug_score. It is market data only and carries no risk verdict: a token on this list is not vetted, and being listed is not a buy signal. Not for one token's price history (get_token_price) or for anything about a wallet (get_wallet_reputation). Arguments: chain and category, both optional; one API unit.

category.description: Which list: trending (default), new (newest launches), gainers; on solana also losers, traded (most volume) and viewed (most scanned on DEFADE). An EVM chain takes trending, new and gainers only; any other value is refused before a request is spent.

chain.description: Chain to list: solana, ethereum, base, bsc, robinhood, arc, hyperevm, monad, elysium. Defaults to solana. EVM chains need a key on an All-Chains plan.

name: get_trending

timestamp.description: ISO time the response was assembled.

trending.description: The listed tokens, in the list's order: each one's address, name, symbol, price, market cap, liquidity, volume and price change as the market source reports them.

title: Trending tokens
